errors.text_span: Диаграмата включва легенда с етикетите на секторите и съответните проценти.
errors.evidence: The description states that the legend includes the percentages for the sectors. However, the legend only contains the labels and their corresponding color markers. The percentages are displayed as data labels directly on the pie slices, not in the legend.

errors.text_span: Сегментите са представени по начин, който показва намаляващ размер, започвайки от сивия сектор, следван от синия и завършвайки с оранжевия.
errors.evidence: The description claims that the segments are presented in decreasing order of size. Visually, this is incorrect. Following the slices clockwise from the top, the order of percentages is 25%, 11%, and 64%, which is not a descending order. While the values themselves can be ordered that way (64 > 25 > 11), the visual arrangement of the slices in the chart does not follow this order.
